output_audit.scope: Post-prediction assistant review of60 fixed changed non-seed tracked outputs, selected evenly from117 outputs displaced at least8native pixels. Compared old/new crops and full frame, then target and +/-3 chronological crops. Visible_ball requires an identifiable ball within approximately12native pixels. Unresolved is not correct. Development diagnostic, not independent ground truth. No verdict enters fusion.

reference_quality_audit.decision: Treat raw agreement with the94reference points as historical consistency only. Frame1912 is a disputed shoe label, and unresolved references cannot establish accuracy. None of these review verdicts enters fusion.

transfer_output_audit.scope: Post-prediction assistant audit of60 evenly spaced outputs from88 originally unresolved reference frames. Frozen original YOLO+verifier predictions; all150 original reference labels stay unchanged. This does not produce a new independent test.
transfer_output_audit.limits: Original reference labels are unchanged. This candidate-specific audit proves wrong locations, not absence of the ball elsewhere. It is assistant review after predictions, not independent human ground truth.

surface_filter.scope: Post-audit exploratory setting; one airborne ball rejected. No default replay change.

detector_new_games.decision: Retain YOLO. No new detector demonstrates a gain over it on these samples.
detector_new_games.scope: Six disjoint90second intervals in two recordings. First120samples informed follow-up experiments; final30times were reviewed before opening predictions. All thresholds and weights stayed frozen.
detector_new_games.limits: Sparse assistant labels, not independent human ground truth or full-game accuracy.

protocol.selection: Every one of142 automatically proposed detector-consensus seeds, no manual filtering.
protocol.rule: Only visible_ball verdicts may seed the additional tracker; uncertain, non_ball, missing or incomplete outputs are withheld.
protocol.scope: Development correction prompted by a post-prediction output audit; not an independent evaluation.

protocol.selection: Every one of59 automatically proposed YOLO seeds, no manual filtering.
protocol.rule: Only visible_ball verdicts may seed the additional tracker; uncertain, non_ball, missing or incomplete outputs are withheld.
protocol.scope: Development correction prompted by a post-prediction output audit; not an independent evaluation.

language_model_adjudication.scope: Eight detector-disagreement requests on the already opened 120-sample set; only two evaluable target frames. Exploratory, not independent.

replay_training_followup.decision: None beats the frozen full-frame baseline.

distillation.scope: Model-generated labels, small time-separated same-game test and previously opened transfer frames.

runtime_fix.scope: Matched runtime controls, not unprompted ball accuracy.

cost_note: Conservative estimate including reserved cost for incomplete pilot calls; not an invoice. Modal compute is separate.
limits: Sparse assistant review, not independent human ground truth.
Policies and prompt choice were tuned using development checks.
SAM can consistently follow the wrong object; agreement is not a calibrated probability.
Context and interpolation are estimates, not observations.
